integrity: All exact fractions are independently reproduced by an included standard-library rational checker from the stated finite face-and-cut reduction. Infinite-dimensional and all-size assertions rely on analytic arguments, not finite extrapolation; historical priority and an independent audit remain open.
scientific_limitations: Exact enumerated coefficients are proved only for two through eight unweighted, equally spaced real observations; the all-size lower bound is not known to be optimal. No nonuniform-weight or nonuniform-design result is claimed.
title: Four-site onset and exact small-sample Gini sensitivity of convex least-squares regression
